mapper.select: select s.actor_type as "actorType", s.subject_id as "subjectId", s.tenant_id as "tenantId", t.status as "tenantStatus", case when s.actor_type = 'member' then exists( select 1 from member_wechat_identity mwi where mwi.id = cast(s.subject_id as bigint) and mwi.member_id is not null ) else true end as bound, case when s.actor_type = 'staff' then coalesce(( select sa.first_login from staff_account sa where sa.id = cast(s.subject_id as bigint) and sa.status = 'active' ), false) else false end as "firstLogin" from auth_session s left join tenant t on t.id = s.tenant_id where s.token_hash = #{tokenHash} and s.revoked_at is null and s.expires_at > current_timestamp
select cast(value_text as integer) from platform_config where config_key = #{configKey} and enabled
insert into tenant(name, city, status, trial_start_at, trial_end_at) values (#{name}, '', 'trialing', #{trialStartAt}, #{trialEndAt}) returning id
insert into owner_wechat_identity(tenant_id, openid) values (#{tenantId}, #{openid}) returning id
insert into member_wechat_identity(openid) values (#{openid}) returning id
select count(*) from staff_account where id = #{staffId} and status = 'active'
